verdict.rationale: Teams platform docs include a dedicated 'Agent slash commands' page in the agent/bot feature set, alongside message extensions invoked from the compose box. Together these indicate developers can register custom commands that users invoke from the message box, though the evidence is only navigation titles. Missing for 10: detailed evidence of how commands are registered (e.g., manifest definition) and how they surface and are invoked in the message box, plus any independent or hands-on corroboration.
